Name: Drone Warehouse
Author: Jaimsss
Description:
[size=6]Drone Warehouse (SMAPI)[/size] — drones for your farm

(В вкладке articles подробное описание основных механик на русском)

What is this?
This mod adds a "Drone Warehouse" building and four types of drones:

- Gatherer — collects ripe garden beds (except flowers) and natural bounty.
- Irrigator — finds dry plowed fields and waters them, refilling from water/wells/hatch (configurable).
- Stroker — pets outdoor animals and pets.
- Farmer — processes cages using beacons: loosens/plows, plants seasonal seeds from the warehouse chest, removes small debris (grass/rocks/branches/weeds) with automatic loot added to the chest.

[size=5]Features[/size]
- Queue and animation for takeoff/landing through a hatch, opening/closing sounds.
- A* navigation with bypass of buildings and "no-fly" zones.
- Prioritize landing based on proximity to hatches, holding at the "holding point."
- Reasonable rendering depths (over the facade near the hatch).
- Auto-save of chest contents and farmer drone tasks.
- Virtual zones with selection (3x3 / 5x5 / 7x7) for Farmer-drone planting seeds (By pressing F6, when iyou have farmer drone).
- Menu with current landings for farming drones (By pressing F3, in the presence of created farming drones).
- All cells from zones are queued for the farmer drone.
- Languages available in the game: Ru, En, Es

[size=5]Requirements[/size]
- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI 4.x+

[size=5]Installation[/size]
1. Install SMAPI:
2. Unzip the archive to the [i]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/i] folder so that the resulting folder is [i]Mods/DroneWarehouseMod/[/i].
3. Launch the game via SMAPI.

Update: Delete the old mod folder and copy the new one.
Uninstall: Delete the [i]DroneWarehouseMod[/i] folder. (Safe for saves.)

[size=5]How to Use[/size]
- Build a "Drone Warehouse" and open its menu.
- Craft drones and upgrade the warehouse to access other types.
- For the drone farmer: select zones (virtual) and/or place beacons (torches with special metadata); take seeds from the chest inside the warehouse.
- Press Start (if a menu is available) — the drone farmer will complete the entire queue.
- The waterer takes the nearest dry cages; if there is no water, it can refill at the hatch (optional).
- The pet drone pets outdoor animals and pets, counting those already "petted" today.

[size=5]Configuration[/size]
File [i]Mods/DroneWarehouseMod/config.json[/i]:
- Drone speed and capacity, scanning frequency.
- "Hatch" radius, hatch offsets, drawing under trees/over the facade.
- Waterer refill behavior (water source/hatch).
- Beacon allocation sizes (3/5/7).

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
- Singleplayer — supported.
- Co-op — logic is included, but reliable operation is guaranteed if the host has installed the mod.
Clients don't need the mod, but it's recommended.
- Mods that add or change buildings and collisions may affect routes — we take line-of-sight and no-fly zones into account.

[size=5]Known Issues[/size]
- ⚠️ In some cases, unreported bugs or minor lags are possible. The cause is not yet clear; if you notice a pattern, please report it to the bug tracker (see link below).
- In extremely densely populated areas, drones may take long detours.
- The tea-like "bushes" from the mods are ignored by drone gatherers. (I can't get them to assemble correctly😅).

[size=5]Debugging / Feedback[/size]
- Report bugs, attach [i]smapi-latest.txt[/i]: (link to GitHub issues).
- Suggestions on balance and UX are welcome.
